Inclusion of Rajasthani language in
the Eighth Schedule
*301. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
considered the unanimous resolution passed
by the Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha to include
Rajasthani language in the Eighth Schedule
of the Constitution; and
(b) if so, the action/decision taken in
this regard?
Development of Chanderi under IIUS
†*302. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
for Chanderi under the Industrial
Infrastructure Upgradation Scheme
involving Rs. 887.50 lakh, has been received
from the Government of Madhya Pradesh;
and
(b) if so, the present status of the
proposal and by when it would be
approved?
Integrated Handloom Cluster
Development Programme
*303. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
handloom sector is the largest source of
employment in rural areas, after agriculture;
(b) whether Government have launched
the Integrated Handloom Cluster
Development Programme for development
of this sector;
(c) if so, whether it is a centrally funded
project; and
(d) if so, the details of clusters being
developed in Orissa and the amount of
Central aid since provided to these centres?
Transport subsidy to tea exporters
*304. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the South Indian Tea
Exporters Association has requested the
Union Government for extension of the
transport subsidy;

95
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by the Central
Government in this regard so that the Tea
exporters from South India are able to
compete with neighbouring countries?
Market forces discriminating in
fixing Tobacco prices
*305. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry is aware of
the market forces that are discriminating in
fixing prices and exports of export variety
Tobacco between the States; and
(b) if so, what is the share of exports
from Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh?
Employment generation under new
economic reforms
*306. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of employment
opportunities generated under the new
economic reforms, during the current
financial year;
(b) the target of employment
opportunities expected to be generated
during the next financial year; and
(c) the reaction of the Union
Government on the achievements of the
targets fixed?
Rajiv Gandhi Shramik Kalyan Yojana
*307. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what are the details regarding the
target fixed for Rajiv Gandhi Shramik
Kalyan Yojana for the year 2005-06;
(b) on what basis such a target was fixed;
(c) whether it is a fact that this Yojana
has not been able to meet the annual target;
(d) if so, the reason for the under
achievement; and
(e) what steps are being taken to
improve the performance of this Yojana
during the current financial year?
Display of military might
*308. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are allowing
the services to display their full military
might;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the future action plan prepared in
this regard; and
(d) the present status of coming
Republic Day celebrations, to be held in
January, 2007?
Villages to be merged in territory of
Bangladesh due to fencing
†*309. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 40 villages
from Nanjihi to Dauki and from Dauki to
Jalyakhola located on Indo-Bangladesh
border are going to merge within territorial
area of Bangladesh while erecting fence on
the border of India;

(c) the extent of land, India has to lose
due to this fencing;
(d) whether it is also a fact that
Government's attention has been drawn
towards these villages by several Indian
organizations, so that slipping of the said
villages within Bangladesh's territory can
be prevented; and
(e) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Expenditure on NREGS
*310. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state that the total expenditure
on National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme and the type and value of assets
created by this expenditure, as on date?
Pending court cases about defence
deals
*311. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases pending in
various courts with regard to defence
procurement and related issues;
(b) the number of cases in which charge-
sheets have been filed but trials have not
begun;
(c) the total amount involved in all these
cases; and
(d) the total number of persons
presently in custody?
Private and foreign investments in
higher education
*312. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
any steps to encourage private and foreign
investment in higher education;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
are treating higher education as a private
good, rather than merit good, only to satisfy
the GATS conditionality; and
(d) if not, what is the basis for
Government's submission of revised offers
at WTO on August 24, 2005?
Assent to Gujarat Control of
Organised Crime Bill, 2003
*313. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI:
SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Gujarat has
submitted Gujarat Control of Organised
Crime Bill, 2003 for the assent of
Government of India;
(b) if so, when the Bill was received;
(c) the salient provisions of the Bill;
(d) whether Government have approved
such Bills in other States; if so, in which
States; and
(e) whether Government intend to give
assent to the Gujarat Control of Organised
Crime Bill, 2003; if so, by when and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Specific areas for manufacturing
units
*314. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under

97
consideration of Government to set up five
specific areas for setting up of
manufacturing units, involving single
window clearance mechanism, liberal land
acquisition norms and labour laws;
(b) if so, whether such units will cater
entirely to exports or a part of it will be for
domestic markets;
(c) whether the manufacturing  units in
such areas will be insulated against the
stringent labour laws, such as Industrial
Disputes Act, Contracts Act, etc.; and
(d) what is the present stage of the
proposal?
Meeting of police chiefs of North-East
States
*315. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of decisions taken in the
meeting of the police chiefs of the Seven
North-East States as well as West Bengal
and Bhutan, besides senior officers of the
Army, paramilitary forces, the intelligence
agencies and the Union Home Ministry,
held in Guwahati;
(b) whether emphasis has been given
on coordination of various security forces,
anti-insurgency plans and operations more
urgently; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Integrated scheme for development of
powerloom sector
*316. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the powerloom sector has
not received due attention of Government
it deserves, even though this sector
contributes 68 per cent of the total cloth
production of the country and provides
employment to about 48.15 lakh persons;
(b) if so, the steps taken to improve the
powerloom sector;
(c) whether the Standing Committee on
labour has recommended formulation of an
integrated scheme for development of the
powerloom sector; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to formulate
the scheme and to provide necessary
financial help to the sector?
Proposals to tackle terrorism
*317. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
various proposals including amending the
Police Act and introduction of new War on
Terrorism to tackle terrorism in the
country;
(b) if so, whether these proposals were
considered by the Secretaries of Ministries
of Home Affairs and External Affairs,
officials of the Planning Commission,
Cabinet Secretariat, Legal Affairs
Department and the Intelligence Bureau;
and
(c) if so, by when final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?

Employment Workmen

Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:

Strengthening of intelligence
mechanism
†*319. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating any plan to strengthen the
intelligence mechanism of the country and
to fix its accountability;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is  a fact that some of the
incidents of terrorism took place recently
are because of weakness of intelligence
mechanism;
(d) if so, the details of such incidents
alongwith the details of the action taken by
Government; and

by Government to strengthen the
intelligence mechanism at district level?

production

DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Armed
forces have to depend on foreign countries
even today for getting modern arms and
equipments, despite the claims of self-
sufficiency in every field in the country;

country has not achieved the desired
success in the field of defence research and
innovation as per the circumstances and
the needs;

approach in respect of defence research does
